characterization_methods: X-ray diffractometer (XRD) with X-ray reflection (XRR) method
evidence: X-ray diffractometer SmartLab (Rigaku ™) was used to evaluate the thickness, density and surface roughness by the X-ray reflection (XRR) method and to characterize the crystal structure by grazing incidence X-ray diffraction (GIXRD) method. The Raman spectra were recorded with a Renishaw inVia microRaman spectrometer. Information on the mass thickness and impurity content in the films was acquired from X-ray fluorescence spectroscopy (XRF) measurements. The RMS surface roughness was measured also by the atomic force microscopy (AFM) using Autoprobe CP II (Veeco Instruments Inc.). In order to determine the refractive index values and obtain supporting information on film thickness, we employed spectroscopic ellipsometer GES5-E (SEMILAB, Sopra).
